translations.web: But the shameful thing has devoured the labor of our fathers from our youth, their flocks and their herds, their sons and their daughters.
translations.bsb: From our youth, that shameful god has consumed what our fathers have worked for— their flocks and herds, their sons and daughters.
translations.kjv: For shame hath devoured the labour of our fathers from our youth; their flocks and their herds, their sons and their daughters.
